title: 7-Day Attention Recovery
description: Your attention leaks through a thousand small holes. This program helps you reclaim your focus.

days.title: The Attention Audit
days.insight: Where does your attention go? What's pulling it away? Identify your distractions.
days.action: Track your attention for one hour. When you notice your attention has wandered, write down: where did it go?
days.reflectionQuestion: Where does my attention go when it wanders?

days.title: The 25-Minute Focus Block
days.insight: Deep work happens in focused blocks. Start small and build up.
days.action: Set a timer for 25 minutes. Focus on one task. No phone. No email. Nothing else.
days.reflectionQuestion: What task deserves 25 minutes of focus?

days.title: The Phone Detox
days.insight: Your phone is designed to capture your attention. Take it back.
days.action: Put your phone in another room for 2 hours. See what it feels like to focus without the pull.
days.reflectionQuestion: What would happen if my phone wasn't nearby?

days.title: The Single-Task Challenge
days.insight: Multitasking is a myth. You're just switching between tasks, draining your attention.
days.action: Today, do one thing at a time. Finish what you start before moving to the next.
days.reflectionQuestion: What can I finish before starting something else?

days.title: The注意力 Reset
days.insight: When attention is scattered, reset. Return to the present moment.
days.action: When you notice your attention is scattered, pause. Take 3 deep breaths. Ask: what's happening right now?

days.title: The Environment Check
days.insight: Your environment shapes your attention. Create a focus-friendly space.
days.action: Clean your workspace. Remove one distraction. Add one thing that helps you focus.

days.title: The Focus Celebration
days.insight: You've reclaimed your attention. Celebrate your focus.
days.action: Write down three moments today when you focused deeply. Celebrate your focus.
days.reflectionQuestion: When did I focus deeply today?
